newsitem.title: FRANCE: Current yen would lower Japan GDP forecasts - OECD.
newsitem.headline: Current yen would lower Japan GDP forecasts - OECD.

text.p: OECD chief economist Stephen Potter said on Thursday that forecasts for Japanese growth contained in the OECD's economic outlook report would be lower if current yen levels were taken into account. The OECD report forecast real GDP growth of 2.3 percent for 1997 and 2.9 percent for 1998.

Potter told reporters that this forecast was based on an exchange rate of 127 yen to the dollar but that at current rates of around 112 yen the growth forecasts would more likely be in the region of 2.1 percent for 1997 and 2.5 percent for 1998.
